title: Bairui granules attenuate ulcerative colitis via microbial-metabolite crosstalk and Isorhamnetin-3-O-glucoside-mediated JAK2/STAT3 suppression.
authors: Zhang, Fang; Xu, Haonan; Che, Ke; Cui, Yu; Yao, Qisheng; Sun, Tingting; Che, Yan; Chen, Hao
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药颗粒对溃疡性结肠炎的作用机制，核心是肠道菌群代谢与JAK2/STAT3信号通路，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUD: Bairui Granules (BRKL), a standardized botanical drug derived from Thesium chinense Turcz., has been clinically used for respiratory infections. However, its potential in ulcerative colitis (UC) and underlying mechanisms remain unexplored. This study elucidated the therapeutic effects and mechanisms of BRKL against UC through integrated phytochemistry, multi-omics, and pharmacological approaches. METHODS: We investigated the protective effects of BRKL on DSS-induced colitis in mice. Pathological characteristics and oxidative stress of the distal colon were assessed. The impact of BRKL on gut microbiota was analyzed using 16S rRNA sequencing, while metabolomics explored changes in small molecular metabolites. UPLC-QE-MS validated BRKL's prototype compounds in the bloodstream, and network pharmacology predicted its targets and pathways. Molecular docking/dynamics validated target engaagement, followed by experimental validation in vitro and in vivo. RESULTS: BRKL significantly alleviated colitis symptoms, restored gut barrier integrity, and reduced oxidative stress. It reshaped gut microbiota composition (Akkermansia, Lachnospiraceae; Escherichia-Shigella) and modulated 22 colon metabolites linked to histidine and JAK-STAT pathways. Network pharmacology identified JAK2 as a core target, corroborated by molecular dynamics showing stable binding of BRKL-derived Withalongolide L to JAK2. BRKL and its active component Isorhamnetin-3-O-glucoside (0.1 mg/g crude drug) suppressed IL-6/JAK2/STAT3 phosphorylation, reduced apoptosis, and inhibited pro-inflammatory cytokines . Structural analysis confirmed Isorhamnetin-3-O-glucoside as a novel JAK2 inhibitor scaffold (Tanimoto index <0.3 vs. clinical inhibitors). CONCLUSION: BRKL ameliorates UC by synchronously modulating gut microbiota-metabolite interactions and blocking the JAK2/STAT3 pathway. Isorhamnetin-3-O-glucoside are identified as key bioactive compounds, positioning BRKL as a promising phytotherapeutic for inflammatory bowel disease.
abstract_zh: 背景：百蕊颗粒（BRKL）是一种源自百蕊草（Thesium chinense Turcz.）的标准化植物药，已在临床上用于呼吸道感染。然而，其在溃疡性结肠炎（UC）中的潜力及潜在机制尚未被探索。本研究通过整合植物化学、多组学和药理学方法，阐明了BRKL对抗UC的治疗效果及机制。方法：我们研究了BRKL对DSS诱导的小鼠结肠炎的保护作用。评估了远端结肠的病理特征和氧化应激。利用16S rRNA测序分析BRKL对肠道微生物群的影响，而代谢组学则探索了小分子代谢物的变化。UPLC-QE-MS验证了BRKL在血液中的原型化合物，网络药理学预测了其靶点和通路。分子对接/动力学验证了靶点结合，随后进行了体外和体内实验验证。结果：BRKL显著缓解了结肠炎症状，恢复了肠道屏障完整性，并减少了氧化应激。它重塑了肠道微生物群组成（阿克曼菌属、毛螺菌科；埃希氏菌-志贺氏菌属），并调节了与组氨酸和JAK-STAT通路相关的22种结肠代谢物。网络药理学将JAK2确定为核心靶点，分子动力学证实BRKL衍生的Withalongolide L与JAK2稳定结合。BRKL及其活性成分异鼠李素-3-O-葡萄糖苷（0.1 mg/g生药）抑制了IL-6/JAK2/STAT3磷酸化，减少了细胞凋亡，并抑制了促炎细胞因子。结构分析确认异鼠李素-3-O-葡萄糖苷为一种新型JAK2抑制剂骨架（与临床抑制剂的Tanimoto指数<0.3）。结论：BRKL通过同步调节肠道微生物群-代谢物相互作用并阻断JAK2/STAT3通路来改善UC。异鼠李素-3-O-葡萄糖苷被确定为关键生物活性化合物，使BRKL成为炎症性肠病的一种有前景的植物治疗药物。
